The unit is labeled 'P105' and 'AUSTIN' in white paint on the casing.
A 'Goodman Transmission' brand sticker is visible on the side of the casing in photo 1.
The casing shows significant surface rust and dirt, suggesting it has been stored for some time.
The output shaft is visible at the front, and the input shaft is visible at the rear.
The seller claims it is for a Chevrolet Express and is American-made, but the specific model and fitment are not confirmed by the photos.
